title: 第005章 吊唁第006章 外人不得入内
content_zh:
第005章吊唁
早上七点十分，陈默洗漱完毕，刚从外面吃完早餐，老妈李素芳电话就打了过来。
“小默，你马上坐车来汉阳机场，跟我一起去燕京参加你姥姥的葬礼！”李素芳的声音有些沙哑，明显哭过了。
时隔六百年，陈默第一次听到老妈声音，恍若隔世。
短暂的沉默后，陈默柔声道：“老妈，我马上过去，您，节哀顺变！”
“嗯，我在机场等你，你快点过来。”
挂断电话，陈默锁门离开，在路上拦了一辆出租车，对师傅说道：“师傅，汉阳机场！”
武州市和汉阳市之间，间隔大约二百公里，走高速两个小时差不多就能到。
听到要跑长途，胖司机一阵兴奋，这一趟下来，能顶他在市区跑十天。
出租车上，陈默闭目沉思，陷入回忆。
陈默的老妈李素芳并不是普通人，乃是燕京六大超级世家之一的李家之人。
李家这些年来不论是在军方，还是政坛，都有深厚的影响力，权势之大，足以影响华夏国未来决策。
但，李素芳跟娘家的关系并不好，几乎翻脸成仇。
当年，陈默父亲陈兢业跟李素芳是大学同学，自由恋爱，可由于身份差距太大，这段恋情遭到李家从上到下所有人的反对，并一度成为燕京其他家族的笑柄。
可李素芳性格执拗，一心一意要嫁给陈兢业，甚至不惜离家出走，与家族决裂。
李家家主李东阳，也就是陈默的外公，恼羞成怒放出话来，如果李素芳嫁给陈兢业，那就把她逐出李家。
李素芳得知父亲如此绝情，伤心欲绝，但却毫不退缩，孤身一人离开燕京，嫁给陈兢业。
而李家说到做到，在陈默父母婚礼当天，宣布把李素芳逐出李家，再无瓜葛。并严令李家以及李家所有附属家族，任何一人都不准前去参加陈默父母婚礼。
李家的强硬表态，导致在婚礼当天，李素芳的娘家人，一人未到。本应该喜气洋洋的婚礼，却沉重异常。
婚后，李素芳对家族心灰意冷，并暗暗发愤图强，一定要闯出一番事业，让李家人刮目相看！

受到打击的不只是李素芳，作为男人的陈兢业同样深感耻辱。
为了证明李素芳没有看错自己，毕业后拒绝了本家人的帮助，孤身一人来到凤山县这个小县城，从小职员做起，凭借自身实力，一步一个脚印，终于当上了副禛长。
可是，不靠关系，不靠背景，想要在往上爬，不知道有多难，所以虽然陈兢业大半辈子兢兢业业，却也只能止步于副禛长，再无寸进。
以至于在李素芳出事后，整日借酒消愁，郁闷成疾，紧跟着逝去。
所以，造成前世陈默父母双亡的结局，李家，也算是罪魁祸首之一。
李素芳和李家的关系，一直到李素芳成立美华集团，并且把美华集团成功做到上市，才有所缓和。
在最疼爱李素芳的母亲，也就是陈默姥姥的劝说下，李东阳才同意，把李素芳和陈默，重新归入门墙。允许李素芳每年，去看望母亲一次。
李素芳还好，虽然不受李家人待见，可毕竟血浓于水，有着多年亲情，李家人并未拿她如何。
可陈默在李家人眼中，却是一个彻头彻尾的外人，李家年轻一代甚至直接称呼陈默，杂种。

Chapter 005 Condolences
At 7:10 in the morning, after Chen Mo had finished washing up and had just finished breakfast outside, his mother Li Sufang called.
"Xiao Mo, you take a car to Hanyang Airport immediately and go to Yanjing with me to attend your grandma's funeral!" Li Sufang's voice was a little hoarse, and she had obviously cried.
After six hundred years, Chen Mo heard his mother's voice for the first time, and it felt like a lifetime ago.
After a short silence, Chen Mo said softly: "Mom, I'll be there right away. Please give me my condolences!"
"Well, I'll wait for you at the airport. Come here quickly."
After hanging up the phone, Chen Mo locked the door and left. He stopped a taxi on the road and said to the master, "Master, Hanyang Airport!"
The distance between Wuzhou City and Hanyang City is about 200 kilometers, and it can be reached in about two hours by highway.
The fat driver was excited when he heard that he was going to run a long distance. This trip would last him ten days in the city.
In the taxi, Chen Mo closed his eyes and thought deeply, falling into memories.
Chen Mo's mother Li Sufang is not an ordinary person, but a member of the Li family, one of the six super aristocratic families in Yanjing.
The Li family has had profound influence over the years, both in the military and in politics, and is powerful enough to influence Huaxia's future decisions.
However, the relationship between Li Sufang and her mother's family was not good, and they almost turned against each other.
At that time, Chen Mo's father Chen Jingye and Li Sufang were college classmates and fell in love freely. However, due to the huge gap in status, this relationship was opposed by everyone in the Li family from top to bottom, and became a laughing stock of other families in Yanjing.
But Li Sufang was stubborn and wanted to marry Chen Jingye wholeheartedly, even running away from home and breaking up with the family.
The head of the Li family, Li Dongyang, Chen Mo's grandfather, became so angry that if Li Sufang married Chen Jingye, she would be expelled from the Li family.
Li Sufang was heartbroken when she learned that her father was so heartless, but she did not flinch. She left Yanjing alone and married Chen Jingye.
The Li family kept their word and announced on the day of Chen Mo's parents' wedding that they would expel Li Sufang from the Li family and have nothing to do with it anymore. He also strictly ordered no one from the Li family and all affiliated families of the Li family to attend the wedding of Chen Mo's parents.
As a result of the Li family's strong stance, no one from Li Sufang's natal family arrived on the wedding day. What should have been a joyous wedding turned out to be extremely heavy.
After her marriage, Li Sufang became disillusioned with her family, and secretly worked hard to get better. She must make a career and impress the Li family!
It was not just Li Sufang who was hit. As a man, Chen Jingye also felt deeply humiliated.
In order to prove that Li Sufang was not wrong about herself, she refused the help of her family after graduation and came to Fengshan County alone. She started as a clerk, relied on her own strength, step by step, and finally became the deputy chief.
However, it is difficult to climb up without relying on connections or background. Therefore, although Chen Jingye has worked hard for most of his life, he can only stop at the position of deputy chief and make no progress.
So after Li Sufang's accident, she drank all day long to drown her sorrows, became depressed and became ill, and soon passed away.
Therefore, the Li family can be considered one of the culprits for the death of Chen Mo's parents in his previous life.
The relationship between Li Sufang and the Li family did not ease until Li Sufang established Meihua Group and successfully listed Meihua Group.
Only after the persuasion of Chen Mo's grandmother, Li Sufang's mother who loved Li Sufang the most, did Li Dongyang agree to return Li Sufang and Chen Mo to the door wall. Li Sufang is allowed to visit her mother once a year.
Fortunately, Li Sufang was not favored by the Li family, but after all, blood was thicker than water, and they had many years of family ties, so the Li family did not do anything to her.
But in the eyes of the Li family, Chen Mo was a complete outsider. The younger generation of the Li family even directly called Chen Mo, a bastard.
